subject: Unforeseen electrical field condition: junction box location conflicting with the ceiling

messages.text: We de-energized the circuit and logged the junction box location conflicting with the ceiling grid layout at Lobby 101 in today's field log; this isn't reflected in Electrical Detail 2/E502. This is routine and can be worked into the normal schedule. We do not expect this to affect the contract sum. No broader schedule impact is expected. Please respond within five days so we can proceed.
